title: Claude Code MCP server configuration (.mcp.json)
description: MCP server configuration for a Claude Code plugin: the contents of .mcp.json at the plugin root, either a map of server name to server config wrapped in "mcpServers", or that map with the wrapper omitted. The same map is accepted inline as plugin.json's mcpServers (mcp-servers.schema.json defines that map once).
$comment: Entry point for a plugin's .mcp.json: the server map, wrapped in mcpServers or bare (a plugin's .mcp.json may omit the wrapper). The map itself is mcp-servers.schema.json, also the inline mcpServers of plugin.json.
